verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single mention that, when Decision Center is enabled, policies can be configured at the Sale checkpoint and applied to orders. That suggests a first-party policy or rules capability, but nothing shows what those policies can contain or what decisions they produce. Missing for 10: documentation of authoring custom rules, combining model scores, velocity counters, list matches, and transaction attributes in conditions, allow/block/review outcomes, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, I can author custom rules that combine model scores, velocity counters, list matches, and transaction attributes into allow, block, or review decisions

citations.quote: If Decision Center is enabled, policies for Sale events can be configured at the Sale checkpoint, and they will be applied to orders created via requests to this endpoint.
